rejection_summary.title: Apollo Has Fallen
rejection_summary.reason: The eight-episode action-thriller's espionage, virus conspiracy and mercenary premise are corroborated by Canal+ and series listings, but available material does not independently establish sustained physical action across the whole season; do not infer action density from genre or promotional descriptions.

rejection_summary.title: Duel
rejection_summary.reason: Reviews substantiate sustained truck pursuit and suspense, but the single repeated road-threat mode limits action variety and setting variety; without enough corroboration to complete the required independent 33-dimension DNA assessment and guardrails, do not stage as a candidate.

rejection_summary.title: Kite
rejection_summary.reason: Available reviews describe assassin violence and animated action, but the required whole-runtime action-density evidence and complete DNA assessment remain insufficient; adult sexual-violence material also requires careful context rather than an unsupported fit claim.
